events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, the legendary John Cleese is 87 today. Still making us laugh after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as "The White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury, forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," on this day in 1965.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: A true game-changer. 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie, forever changing the sound of music.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: The iconic riff master, Jimmy Page, is 83 today. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of rock and pop, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Rod Stewart is 82 today. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... the one and only Suggs from Madness is 66 today!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The soulful voice behind hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home... and today, Paul Young turns 71! Still an 80s icon.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous! The one and only Dolly Parton is 81 today.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and successful solo artist Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: He's still got the magic! Gary Barlow from Take That is 56 today. What's your favourite Take That classic?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car! Billy Ocean is 77 today. Still bringing the sunshine.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock royalty was officially inducted. The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame ceremony happened today in 1989. Who was your favourite original inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Another Take That legend celebrating! Mark Owen is 55 today. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the roof for their final live show. An iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: He's still got that 'In The Air Tonight' drum fill in our heads! Phil Collins is 76 today.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The celebrated British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: From Notting Hill to Wonka, the charming Hugh Grant is 67 today. What's your favourite of his films?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack since the 90s! Justin Timberlake is 46 today. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! The legendary Sir David Jason is 87 today. What's your favourite of his iconic characters?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 1959.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: 68 years ago, music lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The iconic 80s pop star Rick Astley, known for his hit "Never Gonna Give You Up," celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down! Rick Astley is 61 today. Still a pop legend.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: One love, one heart. The incomparable Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential singer-songwriter Carole King, known for "Tapestry" and countless hits, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: On air
angles.copy: From songwriting legend to iconic performer, Carole King is 85 today. Her music is timeless.
